newsitem.title: USA: Patterson Energy files to sell 1.7 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Patterson Energy files to sell 1.7 mln shrs.

text.p: Patterson Energy Inc said it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell an additional 1,727,000 million shares of its common stock.
Of the 1,727,000 shares, the company will issue 1.5 million and stockholders 227,000, the company said.

The company will use the proceeds from the offering to pay down debt, upgrade 15 land rigs it acquired during November and December, and for general corporate purposes. It may also buy drilling rigs and equipment, it said.
Prudential Securities will manage the offering, after which the company will have about 6.44 million shares.
